subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Calpurnia scratched in her handbag and brought _______ a battered leather coin purse.
solution:
The correct answer is '**forth**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**forth**" means forward in time or place. (आगे)
 
• In the given context, Calpurnia brought something forward from her handbag.
 
• The other options: "**fore**," "**four**," and "**fourth**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Calpurnia scratched in her handbag and brought forth__ a battered leather coin purse.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fore (सामने)**: means situated or placed in front.
 
• **Four (चार)**: is a number.
 
• **Fourth (चौथा)**: means the item that comes after the third.
